name: manual_c48278
claim: Extend lesson_32e4248a3949 with a secret-exposure exception: a follow-up deletion commit does not remove the earlier blob from pushed history, so if the stray file held a credential or forbidden attribution token, treat the value as exposed. Revoke or rotate the credential first, then expunge the history only through the sanctioned git-history-surgery procedure (with explicit operator approval for any force-push), and record only the fact of exposure, never the value. Use the plain follow-up deletion only after inspecting the blob and finding nothing sensitive.

decisions.notes: PR 477 review: a follow-up deletion leaves the earlier blob retrievable in pushed history; lesson_32e4248a3949 is graduated and append-only, so this extends it as a new record.

rationale: PR 477 review: a follow-up deletion leaves the earlier blob retrievable in pushed history; lesson_32e4248a3949 is graduated and append-only, so this extends it as a new record.
